title: gitops.application.drifted v1 data
description: An ArgoCD Application's live state diverged from the desired state in Git. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

revision.description: Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from.

driftedResources.description: The diverging resources, truncated at 100. `driftedResourceCount` is the true total: an event is a notification, not a transport (subjects.v1.yaml `limits.body_rule`).

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

driftedResourceCount.description: Total diverging resources, which may exceed `driftedResources` length.
